mentl/d0390d8:
The tighten verb turns the first authorable T_OverDeclared into its
own patch: the diagnostic already carries the declared row, the proven
body row, the fn name, and the decl span, MachineApplicable. The
tighten_collector is a collecting forwarder over Diag — every
diagnostic re-performs outward from the arm, sound by the world arc's
deep-handler law, and all three Diag ops carry arms since a
partial-effect handler leaves zero fn slots. The driver rewrites the
decl's with-clause to the proven row, reports old to new, and leaves
the verdict to a fresh check and the gates. Tightening is the
monotone-safe direction: a narrower declaration only shrinks what
callers accumulate. file_line_of becomes the structural projection
file_line renders through.

sonido/d03f77c:
Three editor UX requests:

1. AUTO-RECONNECT ON DELETE. Removing the last node in the chain used to leave the
   Output orphaned (silent graph). ensure_output_connected() now reconnects the
   node nearest the output (rightmost in flow) whenever a remove leaves the Output
   with no input — across the action-bar, Delete-key, and right-click paths.
   Regression test added.

2. ADD/REMOVE NO LONGER 'CLICKY'. Root cause: FAB-add and action-bar-remove ran
   AFTER show() cleared topology_changed, so they updated the visual graph but not
   the audio engine (right-click worked; FAB/action-bar lagged). Extract
   apply_topology_change() and also call it after the overlays, so every add/remove
   recompiles consistently. Plus Delete/Backspace removes the selected node, and the
   effect-palette search auto-focuses so you type-to-add.

3. KEYBOARD CONTROL OF THE FOCUSED CONTROL. The Knob now consumes only Up/Down
   (value nudge) and leaves Left/Right to egui's built-in directional focus — so
   arrows adjust the focused knob up/down and move between knobs left/right. Space
   (play) and Ctrl+Z/Y now gate on whether a TEXT FIELD wants the keyboard (work
   while a knob is focused, not while typing), and Space is consumed so a focused
   knob can't swallow it.

clob/d0e900a:
A capstone written to be understood by a mind that did not build clob: what it
is, what it is not (the core never learns — learn/ is orphaned, embed/unembed
tied, no backward pass), the one unmade fork (reservoir vs trained core), the
pre-registered thresholds to judge it by, and how to resume it.

It exists because the best thing for an unfinished system, absent anyone to
finish it, is legibility, not motion. A half-built self-improver set running
forever drifts and burns its substrate; left clean and findable, it can still
become what it was for. Honesty over apotheosis — the same discipline that
deleted this project's "unsurpassable" rhetoric.
noodles/d0f41af:
Pressing play on an iPhone lit the transport over silence. Three
layers, all iOS. Safari routes Web Audio through the ringer channel,
so the silent switch muted the app while the graph ran - declare the
session as media playback (Audio Session API, iOS 16.4+) and the
switch is ignored the way any music app ignores it. WebKit parks the
context in a non-standard "interrupted" state after a call or screen
lock, and wakeContext only resumed from "suspended" - resume from
anything not running, and kick the context awake on visibilitychange
and pageshow when the transport thinks it is playing. And the unlock
latch set audioReady before init finished: a second tap during a slow
first init (reverb IR plus 915 KB of samples) launched before the
clock started, and a failed init was never retried - memoize the
in-flight init promise and clear it on failure so the next tap
retries instead of playing a lit transport over dead air.
